The extent to which goals matter depends on how consistently the training objectives are reinforced, particularly in scenarios where the model’s helpfulness is repeatedly evaluated and adjusted. Over time, this can lead to predictable behavioral patterns that either amplify or constrain the model’s impact.
implication.label: held
